issue: Official ESC enforcement-register entry. A penalty-notice payment is not treated as a court admission unless the linked official source says otherwise.
outcome: Penalty notice/s
instrument_or_rule: Energy Retail Code of Practice (versions 3), clauses 94(2) and 106(1) Summary: Energy retailer CovaU Pty Ltd has paid penalties totalling $81,404 for alleged price certainty and bill change alert breaches. We issued 2 penalty notice to CovaU after it allegedly: failed to provide bill change alerts at least five business days prior to a price change taking effect increased the tariffs on a day other than a network tariff change date. The alleged breaches took place in August and September 2025. By engaging in the bill change alert conduct, CovaU’s customer were not provided with information about rising costs so they could look for more competitive offers in the market. CovaU’s conduct also undermines the objectives of the price certainty provisions. By increasing the tariffs in September 2025, CovaU created circumstances in which customers could experience a second price increase within 12 months. Media release Penalty Notices
